name: visslm-app-icon
label: VISSLM Agent application icon
preamble: Polished front-facing application icon tiles for a desktop data and AI workstation. The original brand symbol is a data prism: three broad interlocking rounded panels form an open hexagonal lens around one small diamond-shaped data core. The silhouette is compact, balanced, geometric, premium, and unmistakable at 28px. Use a clean rounded-square tile, no letters, no sparkles, no circuit nodes, no charts, no text, and no fragile thin detail.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; rounded-square tile fills about 82% of each cell; prism symbol fills about 62% of the tile; generous optical padding
construction.corner_radius: one consistent large tile radius; the three prism panels share the same soft corner radius; the core is a softly rounded diamond
construction.angles: front-facing geometry constrained to vertical, horizontal, and 60-degree directions
construction.detail_budget: three broad interlocking panels and one small diamond data core only
construction.fill_rule: solid readable silhouette with restrained internal violet shading; no texture and no external shadow
construction.color_rule: locked neutral and violet palette; violet is the only chromatic hue; light-to-dark violet shading stays subordinate to the V silhouette
construction.shared_parts: dark and light variants use exactly the same prism silhouette, panel geometry, diamond core, spacing, and optical scale
construction.shadow: no ground shadow and no shadow cast onto the grey sheet; only subtle internal form shading
construction.motif: three data panels interlock into an open hexagonal lens around a diamond data core
construction.weight_hierarchy: the three-panel prism silhouette is dominant; the central diamond core is smaller and lighter

fits: VISSLM Agent desktop application, sidebar brand mark, title bar icon, and Windows executable icon.
notes: This concept is intentionally independent of previous VISSLM icons. Generate dark and light variants together so their geometry remains matched. Keep the square tile as part of each transparent cutout.
